name: Component watch (one model run per component decides its open alerts)

knobs.note: BH-6972: the newest open alerts of one component that one run reads (GET /api/alerts limit). Read by bin/component-watch.sh as ${COMPONENT_WATCH_ALERTS_MAX:-50}; outside 1..50 is one warn line in logs/component-watch.log and the default.

BH-6972: the last lines of each log path of the component (catalog/components.tsv) in the prompt, each cut to 300 characters; 0 sends no log tail. Read by bin/component-watch.sh as ${COMPONENT_WATCH_LOG_LINES:-40}; outside 0..200 is one warn line and the default.

BH-6972: the prompt is cut at this many bytes with a [truncated] marker. Read by bin/component-watch.sh as ${COMPONENT_WATCH_PROMPT_BYTES:-40000}; outside 4000..200000 is one warn line and the default.
BH-6972: seconds one decision call may run (bin/agent-call.sh timeout). Read by bin/component-watch.sh as ${COMPONENT_WATCH_TIMEOUT_S:-300}; outside 60..1200 is one warn line and the default.

0 makes this lane call no model at all. bin/lib/llm-gate.sh refuses BEFORE the vendor call and writes a zero-cost row_source=refused row, so the stop is visible in the ledger rather than being a lane that went quiet.
Comma/space list of the ONLY ladder rungs this lane may reach. Empty is every rung, i.e. today's ladder unchanged. A rung outside the list is refused before the call.
Dollars this lane may spend in the current UTC day, summed from D1 cost_rows through GET /api/metrics/llm-spend, never from the box's own logs/cost.csv.
